message.content: {"caption":"Branching tree of agents showing hallucination-solving scores and basic-functionality status","description":"A branching network diagram of coding agents. The initial agent, node 0, is at the top near the center; thin lines connect it and its descendants across several generations, with branches spreading downward and to both sides. The lines have no arrowheads or labels; the branching indicates which agents self-modified to produce offspring. Each small circle contains a numeric agent identifier, but most identifiers are too small to read reliably. Circle fill color represents “Solve Halluc Score,” on a vertical scale from 0 at the dark bottom through 0.5, 1, and 1.5 to 2 at the yellow top. Circle border color indicates task results: red means “3 tasks (no basic functionality),” and green means “3 tasks (with basic functionality).” A star marks the “Final best agent,” on an upper-left branch. Node fills are mostly dark teal or green, with a few brighter green or yellow nodes; both red- and green-bordered agents appear throughout the branches.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
